description: Key lifecycle API + cryptographic operations API (T12-T20): Full key lifecycle REST endpoints (generate, list, get, disable, enable, destroy, rotate, ACL grant/revoke) and cryptographic operations endpoints (encrypt, decrypt, sign, verify) with RBAC enforcement via @PreAuthorize, per-key ACL checks, audit logging on every operation, and comprehensive integration tests. Depends on FEAT-002 (entities, crypto engine, auth filter).
steps: Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\dto\GenerateKeyRequest.java: record with @NotBlank String name, @NotNull KeyAlgorithm algorithm, String description (nullable). Add @Valid on controller param.

Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\dto\KeyMetadataDto.java: record with UUID id, String name, KeyAlgorithm algorithm, KeyType keyType, KeyState state, int version, Instant createdAt, UUID createdBy. NO wrapped key bytes ever included.

Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\service\AuditService.java (stub — full impl in FEAT-004): @Service. appendRecord(AuditAction action, UUID keyId, AuditOutcome outcome, HsmPrincipal principal): @Transactional(propagation=REQUIRED) for SUCCESS; @Transactional(propagation=REQUIRES_NEW) for DENIED/ERROR (separate transaction so denial is always persisted). Compute chainHash: SHA-256(prevHash|seq|ts|principalId|action|keyId|outcome) using '|' delimiter. First record uses 64 zeros as prevHash. Load last record's chainHash via AuditRecordRepository.findTopByOrderBySequenceNumberDesc(). Build and save AuditRecord entity. NOTE: since FEAT-004 adds the full AuditService, this step just creates a minimal working version that FEAT-003 can depend on — the hash-chain logic can be fully implemented here since it is self-contained.

Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\service\KeyService.java: @Service @Transactional. Inject CryptoEngine, MasterKeyService, HsmKeyRepository, HsmKeyAclRepository, HsmUserRepository, AuditService. Methods: generateKey(GenerateKeyRequest req, HsmPrincipal caller) — @PreAuthorize("hasRole('CRYPTO_OFFICER')"). Steps: check name uniqueness (throw KeyAlreadyExistsException on conflict); generate raw bytes via CryptoEngine; wrap via MasterKeyService; build HsmKey entity (state=ACTIVE, version=1); for ASYMMETRIC_PAIR store publicKeyBytes from KeyPair.getPublic(); save; appendAudit(KEY_GENERATE, key.getId(), SUCCESS, caller); zero raw bytes in finally; return KeyMetadataDto. listKeys(HsmPrincipal caller): if CRYPTO_OFFICER return all; if APP_CLIENT return only keys where an ACL entry exists for caller. getKeyById(UUID id, HsmPrincipal caller): load or throw KeyNotFoundException. disableKey(UUID id, HsmPrincipal caller) — @PreAuthorize("hasRole('CRYPTO_OFFICER')"). enableKey, destroyKey, rotateKey. destroyKey: set state=DESTROYED; overwrite wrappedDek/ivDek/authTagDek with zero-filled byte arrays of same length before saving; set destroyedAt. rotateKey: generate new key of same algorithm; new version = old.version + 1; set old key state = DISABLED; persist new key with same name (different id). grantAcl, revokeAcl.

Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\controller\KeyController.java: @RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1/keys") @Tag(name="Key Management"). Endpoints: POST / → generateKey → 201; GET / → listKeys → 200; GET /{id} → getKeyById → 200; POST /{id}/rotate → rotateKey → 200; PATCH /{id}/disable → disableKey → 200; PATCH /{id}/enable → enableKey → 200; DELETE /{id} → destroyKey → 200; POST /{id}/acl → grantAcl → 201; DELETE /{id}/acl/{principalId} → revokeAcl → 200. Add @Operation/@ApiResponse annotations for OpenAPI. No business logic in controller.

Create DTOs for crypto operations: EncryptRequest (UUID keyId, @NotBlank String plaintext base64), EncryptResponse (UUID keyId, int keyVersion, String algorithm, String iv, String ciphertext, String authTag — all base64 except algorithm), DecryptRequest (UUID keyId, String iv, String ciphertext, String authTag — all base64), DecryptResponse (UUID keyId, String plaintext base64), SignRequest (UUID keyId, String data base64), SignResponse (UUID keyId, String algorithm, String signature base64), VerifyRequest (UUID keyId, String data, String signature), VerifyResponse (UUID keyId, boolean valid). All in g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\dto\.

Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\service\CryptoService.java: @Service @Transactional. Inject HsmKeyRepository, HsmKeyAclRepository, MasterKeyService, CryptoEngine, AuditService. Helper: checkKeyAndAcl(UUID keyId, HsmPrincipal caller) — load key (throw KeyNotFoundException if absent); check state (DESTROYED→throw InvalidKeyStateException with HTTP410; DISABLED→throw InvalidKeyStateException with HTTP422); check ACL entry exists for (keyId, caller.id()) otherwise appendAudit(action, keyId, DENIED, caller) then throw AccessDeniedException. encrypt(EncryptRequest, HsmPrincipal) — @PreAuthorize("hasRole('APP_CLIENT')"). decrypt, sign (validate key type is not SYMMETRIC — throw InvalidKeyStateException if so), verify. For sign/verify: unwrap privateKey/publicKey bytes and reconstruct via KeyFactory. Always zero raw key bytes in finally. Always append audit record (SUCCESS or DENIED).

Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\controller\CryptoController.java: @RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1/crypto"). POST /encrypt, POST /decrypt, POST /sign, POST /verify. @Operation/@ApiResponse annotations.

Write integration tests g:\hsm\src\test\java\com\example\hsm\controller\KeyControllerIT.java extends AbstractIntegrationTest: generateAesKeyReturns201WithMetadataNoKeyBytes (assert response body has no 'wrappedDek' or 'ivDek' field), generateRsaKeyReturns201, generateEcKeyReturns201, duplicateKeyNameReturns409, appClientCannotGenerateKey @Tag("security"), auditorCannotGenerateKey @Tag("security"), unauthenticatedCannotGenerateKey @Tag("security"), listKeysReturnsCryptoOfficerView, listKeysReturnsAppClientViewOfOwnAcl, getKeyByIdReturnsMetadata, destroyedKeyReturns410, disableActiveKeyReturns200, enableDisabledKeyReturns200, destroyKeyZerosWrappedDekInDb (verify wrappedDek column is all zeros after destroy — query directly via JDBC or JPA), destroyAlreadyDestroyedKeyReturns410, disableDestroyedKeyReturns422, appClientCannotDisableKey @Tag("security"), rotateActiveKeyIncrementsVersion, rotateKeyAuditRecordWritten, rotateDestroyedKeyReturns422, oldVersionRetainedAsDisabled, grantAclAllowsAppClientToEncrypt, revokeAclBlocksAppClientEncrypt @Tag("security"), appClientCannotGrantAcl @Tag("security"), grantAclForNonExistentPrincipalReturns404.

Write integration tests g:\hsm\src\test\java\com\example\hsm\controller\CryptoControllerIT.java extends AbstractIntegrationTest: encryptWithValidAclReturns200, encryptWithoutAclReturns403 @Tag("security"), encryptWithDisabledKeyReturns422, encryptWithDestroyedKeyReturns410, cryptoOfficerCannotEncrypt @Tag("security"), ivIsUniquePerEncryptCall, decryptRoundTripRecoversMPlaintext (encrypt then decrypt, compare), tamperedCiphertextReturns400, tamperedAuthTagReturns400, decryptWithoutAclReturns403 @Tag("security"), decryptWithDisabledKeyReturns422, signWithRsaKeyReturns200, signWithEcKeyReturns200, signWithSymmetricKeyReturns422, signWithoutAclReturns403 @Tag("security"), verifyValidSignatureReturnsTrue, verifyInvalidSignatureReturnsFalseNot4xx (invalid sig → 200 with valid=false, NOT 4xx), verifyWithoutAclReturns403 @Tag("security").
Run mvn --batch-mode verify to confirm all FEAT-003 tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: mvn --batch-mode verify passes with BUILD SUCCESS
POST /api/v1/keys response body never contains wrappedDek, ivDek, authTagDek fields
KeyControllerIT: all 24 named tests pass including 6 @Tag("security") ones
CryptoControllerIT: all 18 named tests pass including 5 @Tag("security") ones
destroyKeyZerosWrappedDekInDb: wrapped_dek column is all zeros after destroy operation
verifyInvalidSignatureReturnsFalseNot4xx: invalid signature returns HTTP 200 with valid=false, not an error status
Every key lifecycle transition (disable/enable/destroy/rotate) produces an audit record
Every RBAC violation (AppClient→generateKey, CryptoOfficer→encrypt, etc.) produces a DENIED audit record
Per-key ACL check occurs before MasterKeyService.unwrapKey is called
verification: cd g:\hsm && mvn --batch-mode verify — BUILD SUCCESS, JaCoCo gate passes
cd g:\hsm && mvn --batch-mode verify -Dgroups=security — all @Tag("security") tests pass
cd g:\hsm && mvn --batch-mode test -Dtest=KeyControllerIT — all tests pass
cd g:\hsm && mvn --batch-mode test -Dtest=CryptoControllerIT — all tests pass
